name: Here is a quantum coding exercise. Simulate time evolution of the 3-site Heisenb
task_prompt: Here is a quantum coding exercise. Simulate time evolution of the 3-site Heisenberg XXZ chain (Jx=Jy=1, Jz=1.14, open boundary) for time t=0.58 in Qiskit using first-order Trotterization with 40 steps. Start from the Neel state and compare <Z_0>(t) against exact evolution with scipy.linalg.expm. Write the full runnable code (all imports included); executing it should print the results.
